title: Lignin polymerization: towards high-performance materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01044B, Review Article

Li Yan, Alberto J. Huertas-Alonso, Hai Liu, Lin Dai, Chuanling Si, Mika H. Sipponen
Native lignin is fragmented during biorefinery processing into heterogeneous oligomers, limiting its material performance. Polymerization strategies hold promise for the design of high-performance lignin-based materials.
